product.title: Humpback Whales in Cabo San Lucas

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this small-group boat looks for humpback whales with a marine biologist on board and a cap of about 12 passengers. The published 2.5-hour route passes the Arch of Cabo San Lucas and the sea lion colony before spending time on open water where whales may splash or travel with calves. Marine park fees and bottled water are included; souvenir photos are offered for purchase rather than required. The meeting point is the CaboTrek office inside Hotel Tesoro on the marina, near dock M-O and the lighthouse. The format suits visitors who want expert commentary without a large party boat. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina, Arch, and Sea of Cortez that define this wildlife morning.

highlights: When in Cabo San Lucas, don’t miss the chance to see humpback whales and other dramatic marine life on this boat tour
Accompanied by a marine biologist onboard, see whales making gigantic splashes
Snap shots of the iconic Arch of Cabo San Lucas and its sea lion colony
